subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular installer architecture now, or keep the public shell installer as one served script with only focused internal refactors?
rationale: The request changes the structure of a public setup surface rather than fixing a broken behavior, and current docs/workflows still assume a single `scripts/install.sh` entrypoint.

options.title: Sponsor guarded split
options.body: Approve a module layout only if the served installer remains a safe single entrypoint and install validation is updated with it.

options.title: Keep focused refactors
options.body: Use this as backlog context and extract or delete sections only when tied to concrete installer bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that the public shell installer should remain monolithic to minimize helper-loading and website-sync risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve a module layout only if the served installer remains a safe single entrypoint and install validation is updated with it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged installer package-manager work makes this the best available owner signal for the split architecture choice.
